senses.gloss: कमल-पत्र- + अक्ष कमल-पत्र- + अक्ष, adj., f. क्षी, adj. having eyes like lotus-leaves.
काम- + आचार काम- + आचार, adj. following one's own will, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 8.
कामचर काम-चर् + अ, adj. One who comes by his own free will. MBh. 4, 222.

कामचार कामचार, i. e. काम-चर् + अ,
 I. adj. Going as one lists, MBh. 13, 4175.
 II. m. Free will, intention, Yājñ. 2, 162.
काम- + आत्मन् काम- + आत्मन्, adj. voluptuous, Man. 7, 27.
कामात्मन् कामात्मन्, i. e. काम-आत्मन्, adj. Voluptuous, Man. 7, 27.
काम- + आश्रम काम- + आश्रम, m. and n. the hermitage of the god of love.
कमल- + आसन कमल- + आसन and जलज-, m. a name of Brahman.
काम- + उदक काम- + उदक, n. an optional oblation of water, Yājñ. 3, 4.

कम् क + म् (old acc. s. n. of किम्), a particle, Indeed, Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 88. 2.
 --Cf. κέν.

कम् कम्, i. 10, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., Hiḍ. 4, 4; Rām. 3, 51, 28), in the pres., impf., imptive., and potent., and optionally in all the other forms, कामय.
 1. To love, MBh. 1, 2400; Rām. 1, 34, 16.
 2. To desire, Sāv. 5, 52; to wish, with infin., MBh. 1, 6582; to intend, with infin., MBh. 3, 2249.
 --Anom. ptcple. of the pres. कामयान, e. g. MBh. 13, 1891; काममन (probably to be corrected to कामयान), Rām. 5, 24, 37; 38.
 --Pf. pass. कान्त.
 1. Loved, Hiḍ. 4, 35.
 2. Amiable, graceful.
 --Comp.
 --Compar. कान्त + तर, Most beautiful, Rām. 3, 17, 6.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. कमनीय.
 1. To be loved, Kumāras. 1, 37.
 2. Beautiful, Bhartṛ. 1, 45.
 काम्य, see separately.
 --Caus. To cause to desire, Rām. 3, 38, 20 (Par.); Ṛt. 6, 30 (Ātm.).
 --With the prep. अति अति, in अति-कान्त, adj. Excessively loved, Bhartṛ. 2, 30.
 --With अभि अभि, To desire, MBh. 1, 3347.
 --With नि नि, To desire, Bhāg. P. 5, 18, 21.
 --Cf. Lat. carus = कम्-र, Beautiful, charming (Grammarians), amo (cf. कतर), amœnus, etc.; κῆδος (aff. δος = त्वस्) κεδνός, etc.; probably O.H.G. gaman; A.S. gamene.
कामित कामित, n. Wish, MBh. 1, 2187.
कामिता कामिता, i. e. कामिन् + ता, f. Love, Hit. i. d. 104.

कमठ कमठ, m.
 1. A tortoise, Pañc. ii. d. 199.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 2, 117.
कामठ कामठ, i. e. कमठ + अ, adj. Belonging or proper to the tortoise, Rām. 1, 45, 30.
कमण्डलु कमण्डलु, m. (and n.) A water-pot used by ascetics and religious students, Man. 2, 64; Rām. 3, 52, 9.
कमन कम् + अन, adj. Desirable, Bhāg. P. 1, 9, 33.

कमल कम् + अल,
 I. n.
 1. A lotus, Nelumbium, Megh. 32.
 2. Water, Kir. 5, 25.
 II. f. ला.
 1. A name of Lakṣmī, Bhāg. P. i. p. xcv.
 2. A proper name, Rājat. 4, 424.
 --Comp.

कामल कामल,
 I. (m. and) f. ला, A disease of the bile, Suśr. 1, 193, 15.
 II. f. ली, A proper name, Hariv. 1453.
कमलाहास् कमलाहास्, a denomin. derived from कमल-आ-हास, Par. To smile like a lotus, Lass. 67, 15.
कमलिनी कमलिनी, i. e. कमल + इन् + ई, f. A group of lotus flowers, Megh. 90.

कम्प् कम्प्, i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 4, 1290).
 1. To move to and fro, Rām. 1, 14, 18.
 2. To tremble, Rām. 3, 53, 61.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. आ-कम्पित, n. Trembling a little, Ragh. 2, 13.
 --Caus. To cause to tremble, Rām. 1, 74, 13; 3, 33, 38 (Ātm.).
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अ-कम्पित, Without being stirred, by themselves, MBh. 4, 1290.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. अ-कम्प्य, immoveable, Rām. 3, 53, 43.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To pity, with loc. and acc., MBh. 14, 29; Rām. 3, 37, 15.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. अनु-कम्पित, [] n. Compassion, Bhāg. P. 1, 9, 22.
 --Caus. To pity, Kumāras. 4, 39.
 --With समनु सम्-अनु, To pity, Ragh. 9, 14.
 --With अभि अभि, To tremble, MBh. 3, 15721 (? v. r.).
 --With आ आ, Caus. To cause to tremble, MBh. 1, 1165.
 आकम्पित, Excited, Ṛt. 6, 32.
 --With उद् उद्, To tremble, Kathās. 15, 2.
 --With प्र प्र, To tremble, Rām. 1, 65, 13.
 --Caus. To cause to tremble, Rām. 3, 25, 26.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दुष्प्रकम्प्य, i. e. दुस्-.
 1. Difficult to be made to tremble, Hariv. 12824.
 2. Difficult to be made to reel, MBh. 5, 718.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, Caus. To cause to tremble, Rām. 5, 6, 16.
 --With प्रति प्रति, Caus.
 1. To cause to tremble, MBh. 4, 298.
 --With वि वि.
 1. To tremble, Bhag. 2, 31.
 2. To retreat (with abl., from), MBh. 4, 109.
 3. To change, Rām. 2, 60, 17.
 विकम्पित, Trembling, Ṛt. 1, 3.
 --Caus. To cause to tremble, Ragh. 11, 19.
 --With सम् सम्, To tremble, MBh. 4, 574.
 --Caus. To cause to tremble, MBh. 1, 1167.
 --Cf. perhaps κάμπτω καμπύλος.

कम्प कम्प् + अ, m. Trembling, Bhartṛ. 1, 50.
 --Comp.

कम्पन कम्प् + अन,
 I. adj., f. ना.
 1. Causing to tremble, MBh. 13, 662.
 II. m.
 1. A certain weapon, Rām. 6, 7, 24.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 2, 117.
 3. The name of a country, Rājat. 5, 446.
 III. f. ना, The name of a river, MBh. 3, 8094.
 IV. n. Trembling, MBh. 3, 13539.
 --Comp.
† कम्ब् कम्ब्, see कर्ब्.

कम्बल कम्बल,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A woollen blanket, MBh. 3, 181.
 2. A woollen garment, Rājat. 5, 460.
 II. m. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 1555.
 --Comp.

कम्बु कम्बु, m. and n.
 1. A shell, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 20.
 2. A bracelet (made of shells, MBh. 2, 2067), MBh. 4, 54.
कम्बोज कम्बोज, m. pl. The name of a country and its inhabitants.

काम्बोज काम्बोज, i. e. कम्बोज + अ,
 I. adj. Originating from Kamboja, Rām. 5, 12, 36.
 II. m. The king of Kamboja, MBh. 1, 6995.
 III. m. pl. The name of the people and of the country of Kamboja, MBh. 1, 2668.

काम काम, i. e. कम् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Wish, Rām. 2, 90, 23.
 2. Desire, Indr. 5, 61.
 3. Love, Man. 2, 94; 214.
 4. Intention, Man. 9, 248.
 5. A desired object, Man. 9, 304.
 6. The god of love, Indr. 5, 49.
 II. acc. कामम्, adv.
 1. At one's pleasure, Man. 2, 189.
 2. Willingly, MBh. 3, 298; Ragh. 12, 75.
 3. With following न, Rather than, Hit. i. d. 125; Man. 9, 89.
 4. Indeed, Śāk. 26, 16.
 5. Only, Rām. 5, 94, 21.
 III. When the latter part of a comp. adj., f. मा.
 1. Desiring, Man. 2, 37.
 2. Loving, Rām. 3, 55, 29.
 3. An infin. ending in तुम् drops its final before it; cf. कर्तुकाम.
 --Comp.
कामकार काम-कार, m. Free will, Rām. 3, 66, 6.
कामकारतस् कामकार + तस्, adv. Voluntarily, Man. 11, 41.

कामग काम-ग (vb. गम्),
 I. adj., f. गा,
 1. Coming by one's own free will, Nal. 18, 23.
 2. Going as one lists, Rām. 3, 48, 5.
 II. f. गा, A lascivious woman, Yājñ. 3, 6.

कामगम काम-गम् + अ, adj., f. मा, Going as one lists, Rām. 5, 13, 5.
 --Comp.
कामचरत्व कामचर + त्व, n. Roving at will, Kathās. 18, 206.
कामचारतस् कामचार + तस्, adv. Through sensual indulgence, Man. 2, 220.
कामज काम-ज (vb. जन्), adj. Produced from love of pleasure, Man. 7, 46; 9, 107.

कामतस् काम + तस्, adv.
 1. By inclination, Man. 3, 12.
 2. At one's pleasure, 5, 90.
 3. Intentionally, 4, 207.
 --Comp.
कामत्व काम-त्व, n. Love of pleasure, Lass. 40, 5.
कामदुघ कामदुघ, i. e. काम-दुह् + अ, adj., f. घा, Yielding every wish, MBh. 13, 3165.
कामदुह् काम-दुह्, adj., nom. sing. -धुक्, Yielding every wish, MBh. 13, 2700.
कामदुह काम-दुह् + अ, adj., f. हा, Yielding every wish, MBh. 3, 12725.
कामन्दकि कामन्दकि, patron. (कमन्दक + इ). A proper name, Pañc. 122, 1.
काममय काम + मय, adj., f. यी, Meeting all wishes, Rām. 4, 33, 6.
कामया काम + या, adv. (either the ved. instr. sing. of काम, or that of a lost noun कामा), For my sake, MBh. 2, 728.
कामरसिक कामरसिक, i. e. काम-रस + इक, adj. Libidinous, Bhartṛ. 3, 51.
कामरूपधर कामरूपधर, i. e. काम-रूप-धृ + अ, adj., f. रा, Changing one's shape as one lists, Rām. 1, 9, 27.
कामरूपिन् कामरूपिन्, i. e. कामरूप + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Changing one's shape as one lists, MBh. 3, 367.
कामलिन् कामलिन्, i. e. कामल + इन्, adj., f. नी, Jaundiced, Suśr. 2, 469, 3.
कामवन्त् काम + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Loving, MBh. 1, 3869.
कामसू काम-ऊ, adj. Granting desires, Ragh. 5, 33.
कामात्मता कामात्मता, i. e. कामात्मन् + ता, f. Sensuality, Man. 2, 2.

कामिक कामिक, i. e. काम + इक,
 I. [] adj., f. की.
 1. Wished, wish, MBh. 13, 6025.
 2. Wishing, 1969.
 3. In सर्वकामिक the aff. इक belongs to the comp. सर्व-काम, Attaining all one's desires, MBh. 3, 13860.

कामिन् कामिन्, i. e. कम + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Desiring, MBh. 13, 7060.
 2. Having sexual intercourse, MBh. 1, 4185.
 II. m. A lover, MBh. 4, 978.
 III. f. नी, A beloved one, Man. 8, 112.
 --Comp.
काम- + कामिन् काम- + कामिन्, adj. fostering wishes, Bhag. 2, 70.

कामुक कामुक, i. e. कम् + उक,
 I. adj., f. का and की, Desirous, Rām. 2, 74, 7.
 II. m. A lover, Rām. 5, 16, 42.
 --Comp.
कामुकत्व कामुक + त्व, n. Lasciviousness, Megh. 25.

काम्पिल्य काम्पिल्य, i. e. काम्पिल (the name of a country) + य,
 I. adj., f. या, Belonging to Kāmpila, Kathās. 25, 53; with पुर or पुरी, or without a subst., ntr. Its capital, MBh. 1, 5512; Rām. 1, 34, 46; Chr. 52, 14.
 II. m. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 21, 32.

काम्य काम्य, i. e.
 I. the ptcple. of the fut. pass. of कम्.
 1. Amiable, Ragh. 6, 30.
 2. Agreeable, Rām. 5, 43, 13.
 3. Precious, Rām. 2, 25, 9.
 II. काम + य, adj. Connected with a wish, [] interested, Man. 12, 89.
 III. f. या, The name of an Apsaras, MBh. 1, 4820.
 IV. f. या, Desire, Man. 5, 27.
 --Comp.
काम्यक काम्य + क, n. The name of a forest, MBh. 3, 218.
काम्यता काम्य + ता f. Beauty, MBh. 13, 1032.
काम- + गति काम- + गति, adj. going as one lists, Ragh. 13, 76.

कम्बु- + ग्रीवा कम्बु- + ग्रीवा,
 I. adj., f. वा, having a neck marked with three lines like a shell, and considered to be indicative of exalted fortune, Rām. 1, 1, 11.
 II. m. a proper name, Pañc. 76, 7.
काम- + चारिन् काम- + चारिन्, adj. 1. moving where one lists, Chr. 58, 4. 2. self-willed, independent, Rām. 3, 52, 38. 3. Desirous, MBh. 13, 2265.
काम-दमिन् + ई काम-दमिन् + ई, f. a proper name, Pañc. 185, 10.
काम- + देव काम- + देव, m. the god of love, Hariv. 270.
काम- + धेनु काम- + धेनु, f. cow that yields every wish, Kathās. 17, 134.
काम- + पूर काम- + पूर, adj. Fulfilling wishes.
काम- + भोग काम- + भोग, m. sensual enjoyment, Rām. 3, 37, 2.
काम-, मदन- + मञ्जरि काम-, मदन- + मञ्जरि, and राग-मञ्जरी, f. proper names.
काम- + रस काम- + रस, m. semination, MBh. 1, 3812.

काम- + रूप काम- + रूप,
 I. n. a shape changing as one lists, MBh. 1, 6077.
 II. adj., f. पा, taking any or every shape at will, Megh. 6.
 III. m. sing. and pl. the name of a country, Ragh. 4, 83.
काम- + वर काम- + वर, m. choosing what one lists, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 45.
कमल- + वर्धन कमल- + वर्धन, m. the name of a king, Rājat. 5, 446.
काम- + वश्य काम- + वश्य, adj. subdued by love, MBh. 3, 11590.
काम- + वासिन् काम- + वासिन्, adj. abiding where one lists, Nal. 13, 55.
काम- + वृत्त काम- + वृत्त, adj. debauched. Man. 5, 154.
कमल- + षण्ड कमल- + षण्ड, n. a multitude of lotuses, Lass. 2. ed. 46, 27.
काम- + सेवन काम- + सेवन, n. wantonness, Lass. 40, 12.
काम- + हैतुक काम- + हैतुक, adj. caused by arbitrariness, i. e. by accident, Bhag. 16, 8.
